name: Form Display Settings (COMPAS CEM)
description: Set how Draw Form draws a form diagram.

inputParameters.name: force_min
inputParameters.description: The smallest load or reaction force magnitude to draw, or the smallest component when Draw Form decomposes the forces. Defaults to 1e-3.

inputParameters.name: arrow_scale
inputParameters.description: The factor that turns a load or reaction force into its arrow length. Defaults to 1.

inputParameters.name: width_min
inputParameters.description: The width in pixels of the edge with the smallest absolute force. Defaults to 1.

inputParameters.name: width_max
inputParameters.description: The width in pixels of the edge with the largest absolute force. Defaults to 8.

inputParameters.name: radius_min
inputParameters.description: The pipe radius in model units of the edge with the smallest absolute force, when Draw Form thickens the edges. Defaults to 0.01.

inputParameters.name: radius_max
inputParameters.description: The pipe radius in model units of the edge with the largest absolute force, when Draw Form thickens the edges, and the radius of the thickened nodes. Defaults to 0.1.

inputParameters.name: thick_sides
inputParameters.description: The number of faces around every pipe, arrow and node sphere when Draw Form thickens the drawing. At least 3. Defaults to 8.

outputParameters.name: settings
outputParameters.description: The display settings for Draw Form.
